description: ADR-017 §5 scoring vectors (network rules 0.1, /v1/ranking version 3). Every worked example of §5.1–§5.3 with its scoring_time, the R5 grid, the ageing word cap, hold and release (R31) and R32. A piece of evidence weighs x = o × t × q × r × d; evidence groups list count pieces alike, pair "each" giving every piece its own business–customer pair. adr_score is the value the ADR prints (4 decimals); score is the stored value (6 decimals), score_int = floor(score × 10^4 + 0.5), ranked from 4000 (R32). A report (mirror) takes the weight of the kept row it names and counts as verified; a replaced row is weighed for it but not summed. Persons: n = K + B, and a customer's broken pieces from one business have r cap 1.
